ai.text: Jordan Greenway carries several pre-deadline signals: an expiring contract that projects to unrestricted free agency, estimated from his age rather than a published status, and a CHI club sitting 15th in the Western Conference, outside the top eight playoff spots. He also holds a modified no-trade clause with a five-team list. Among fits, UTA rates strongest, with a playoff projection and cap space; VAN is possible despite no playoff projection; NJD is possible but would need salary sent back.
